decision_conditions: Condition : 3 - At least one disabled parking space shall be provided near to the entrance of the building, details of which shall be submitted for approval to the Local Planning Authority within 6 weeks of the date of this permission. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 4 - The access doorway to the reception area shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm and a level surface or ramp between the ground and the floor.

Condition : 5 - Within six weeks of the date of this permission, details of lorry access and turning facilities shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for their approval. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Retention of new vehicular and pedestrian entrances and fenestration with associated car parking and landscaping to exisiting buiidlings
